title: Fed decision in December?
description: This event resolves based on the FOMC statement for the December 8-9, 2026 meeting.

markets.question: Will the Fed increase interest rates by 25 bps after the December 2026 meeting?
markets.description: This market will resolve to "Yes" if the Fed raises the upper bound of the target range by 25 bps at its December 2026 meeting.

markets.question: Will the Fed increase interest rates by 50+ bps after the December 2026 meeting?
markets.description: This market will resolve to "Yes" if the Fed raises the upper bound of the target range by 50 bps or more at its December 2026 meeting.

markets.question: Will there be no change in Fed interest rates after the December 2026 meeting?
markets.description: This market will resolve to "Yes" if the Fed leaves the target range unchanged at its December 2026 meeting.

markets.question: US recession by end of 2026?
markets.description: This market will resolve to "Yes" if either of the following conditions is met: two consecutive quarters of negative real GDP growth, or the NBER announces a recession, by December 31, 2026.
